items.title: Trojan Hippo Bench: A Dynamic Benchmark for Persistent Memory Attacks and Defenses in LLM Agents
items.title_zh: Trojan Hippo Bench：LLM 智能体持久记忆攻击与防御的动态基准
items.summary: Trojan Hippo Bench is a dynamic framework for persistent memory attacks and memory-layer defenses, combining an OpenEvolve-based adaptive red-teaming benchmark with capability-aware security-utility analysis. On an email assistant across four memory backends, the undefended attack reached 85-100% success against frontier OpenAI and Google models, while four defenses cut success to 0-5% at widely varying utility costs.

items.title: An open-source spec for orchestration: Symphony
items.title_zh: 编排的开源规范：Symphony
items.summary: OpenAI published Symphony, an open-source specification for Codex orchestration that turns issue trackers into always-on agent systems, aiming to boost engineering output and reduce context switching.

items.title: OpenAI models, Codex, and Managed Agents come to AWS
items.title_zh: OpenAI 模型、Codex 与托管智能体登陆 AWS
items.summary: OpenAI's GPT models, Codex and Managed Agents are now available on AWS, enabling enterprises to build secure AI in their existing AWS environments.

items.title: Are Tools All We Need? Unveiling the Tool-Use Tax in LLM Agents
items.title_zh: 工具就是全部所需吗？揭示 LLM 智能体中的工具使用税
items.summary: The paper shows that tool-augmented reasoning does not necessarily beat native chain-of-thought when semantic distractors are present, and uses a factorized intervention framework to separate prompt-formatting cost, tool-calling protocol overhead and the gain from actually executing tools. It finds that under semantic noise tool gains often fail to offset the "tool-use tax" introduced by the protocol, and its G-STEP inference-time gate yields only partial recovery, suggesting deeper gains require stronger intrinsic reasoning and tool-interaction capabilities.

items.title: Embedding-based In-Context Prompt Training for Enhancing LLMs as Text Encoders
items.title_zh: EPIC：通过基于嵌入的上下文提示训练增强 LLM 文本编码器
items.summary: EPIC replaces discrete in-context demonstrations with continuous embeddings during contrastive training, reducing token overhead while teaching the model to interpret demonstration embeddings as part of the prompt. The method reports new state-of-the-art results on the MTEB benchmark, surpassing frontier models trained solely on public retrieval data.

items.title: Co-Director: Agentic Generative Video Storytelling
items.title_zh: Co-Director：智能体式生成视频叙事
items.summary: Co-Director is a hierarchical multi-agent framework that formulates generative video storytelling as a global optimization problem, using a multi-armed bandit to identify promising creative directions and a local multimodal self-refinement loop to limit identity drift and preserve sequence-level consistency. The authors also introduce GenAD-Bench, a 400-scenario dataset of fictional products for personalized advertising, and report that Co-Director significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines.

items.title: AMMA: A Multi-Chiplet Memory-Centric Architecture for Low-Latency 1M Context Attention Serving
items.title_zh: AMMA：面向低延迟百万上下文注意力服务的多芯粒内存中心架构
items.summary: AMMA is a multi-chiplet, memory-centric architecture for low-latency long-context attention that replaces GPU compute dies with HBM-PNM cubes, roughly doubling available memory bandwidth for memory-bound decode-phase attention. Against an NVIDIA H100, it reports 15.5x lower attention latency and 6.9x lower energy consumption, motivated by reasoning and agentic workloads pushing context toward one million tokens.

items.title: CacheRAG: A Semantic Caching System for Retrieval-Augmented Generation in Knowledge Graph Question Answering
items.title_zh: CacheRAG：面向知识图谱问答检索增强生成的语义缓存系统
items.summary: CacheRAG turns stateless LLM planners for knowledge-graph question answering into continual learners by caching retrieval plans, using a two-stage semantic parsing interface, a Domain-to-Aspect hierarchical index with maximal marginal relevance, and bounded heuristic subgraph expansion. It reports +13.2% accuracy and +17.5% truthfulness on the CRAG dataset over state-of-the-art baselines, arguing that generating retrieval plans in isolation leads to schema hallucinations and limited retrieval coverage.

items.title: AutoSP: Unlocking Long-Context LLM Training Via Compiler-Based Sequence Parallelism
items.title_zh: AutoSP：基于编译器序列并行释放长上下文 LLM 训练
items.summary: AutoSP is presented as the first automated solution for optimizing LLM training for longer contexts, compiling models and applying automated sequence parallelism plus long-context-aware activation checkpointing. It increases training context by up to 2.7x on NVIDIA hardware and 2.5x on AMD over competitive hand-written baselines at negligible runtime cost.

items.title: Hypencoder Revisited: Reproducibility and Analysis of Non-Linear Scoring for First-Stage Retrieval
items.title_zh: Hypencoder 再审视：首阶段检索中非线性打分的可复现性与分析
items.summary: This reproducibility study confirms that the Hypencoder, which replaces fixed inner-product scoring with a query-specific q-net generated by a hypernetwork, beats a similarly trained bi-encoder in-domain and out-of-domain, and that its efficient search substantially cuts query latency with minimal loss. Hard-task support is partial (wins on DL-Hard and FollowIR but not TREC TOT), a Faiss bi-encoder pipeline remains faster, and the non-linear scoring shows no consistent adversarial-robustness disadvantage.

items.title: AI-Enabled Question-Answering for Chartered Accountancy: A Retrieval-Augmented Reasoning Framework
items.title_zh: 面向特许会计的 AI 问答：检索增强推理框架
items.summary: CA-ThinkFlow is a parameter-efficient RAG framework pairing a 14B, 4-bit-quantized DeepSeek-R1 reasoning model with layout-aware Docling extraction that preserves document structure, inserting retrieved context into the prompt while relying on the model's built-in chain-of-thought. On the multi-level CA-Ben benchmark its Scholastic Reliability Coefficient was equal to 68.75% of the results achieved by GPT-4o and Claude 3.5 Sonnet, though the authors note that reasoning over complex regulatory texts such as taxation remains a weakness.

items.title: Polaris: Coupled Orbital Polar Embeddings for Hierarchical Concept Learning
items.title_zh: Polaris：用于层次概念学习的耦合轨道极坐标嵌入
items.summary: Polaris is a polar hyperspherical embedding framework that separates semantics from hierarchy using angular geometry and radius, combined with local constraints, global regularization and uncertainty-aware asymmetric objectives. Across taxonomy-expansion settings including trees, multi-parent DAGs and multimodal hierarchies, it reports gains of up to about 19 points in top-K retrieval and up to 60% lower mean rank over fourteen baselines.

items.title: Why Do LLMs Struggle in Strategic Play? Broken Links Between Observations, Beliefs, and Actions
items.title_zh: 为什么 LLM 在策略博弈中表现不佳？观测、信念与行动之间的断裂
items.summary: Experiments with Llama 3.1, Qwen3 and gpt-oss identify two gaps in LLM decision-making in incomplete-information games: an observation-belief gap, where internal representations of latent states are more accurate than verbal reports but brittle under multi-hop reasoning and drift from Bayesian coherence, and a belief-action gap, where acting optimally on decoded beliefs would improve payoffs in about 95% of games. The authors argue these systematic vulnerabilities warrant caution before deploying LLMs in strategic domains without robust guardrails.

items.title: Claw-Eval-Live: A Live Agent Benchmark for Evolving Real-World Workflows
items.title_zh: Claw-Eval-Live：面向持续演化真实工作流的实时智能体基准
items.summary: Claw-Eval-Live is a live benchmark for workflow agents that refreshes a signal layer across releases and logs task execution, addressing benchmarks that freeze a task set at release time and grade only the final response. It drew 40 Hugging Face daily-paper upvotes.

items.title: GeoContra: From Fluent GIS Code to Verifiable Spatial Analysis with Geography-Grounded Repair
items.title_zh: GeoContra：从流畅 GIS 代码到可验证空间分析的地理约束修复
items.summary: GeoContra represents each LLM-driven GIS task as an executable geospatial contract and applies static rule inspection, runtime validation and semantic verification, feeding violations into a bounded repair loop. Across 7,079 real geospatial tasks, it raised spatial correctness from 47.6% to 77.5% for DeepSeek-V4 and from 57.7% to 81.5% for Kimi-K2.5.

items.title: SURGE: SuperBatch Unified Resource-efficient GPU Encoding for Heterogeneous Partitioned Data
items.title_zh: SURGE：面向异构分区数据的超高批量、资源高效 GPU 嵌入编码
items.summary: SURGE is a streaming GPU encoding system deployed in production to generate embeddings for more than 800 million texts across 40,000 logical partitions. On 10 million texts with four NVIDIA L4 GPUs it delivered 26,413 texts per second while using 12.6x less memory than fixed-size batching.

items.title: Interactive Multi-Turn Retrieval for Health Videos
items.title_zh: 面向健康视频的交互式多轮检索
items.summary: The authors introduce MHVRC, a multi-turn health video retrieval corpus built from video-grounded descriptions and DeepSeek-generated query refinements, and propose DATR, a dialogue-aware two-stage retrieval framework. DATR combines CLIP-style coarse retrieval with multi-turn query fusion and cross-encoder re-ranking, showing consistent gains over strong text-video retrieval baselines.

items.title: SciResearcher: Scaling Deep Research Agents for Frontier Scientific Reasoning
items.title_zh: SciResearcher：为前沿科学推理扩展深度研究智能体
items.summary: SciResearcher is a fully automated agentic framework that synthesizes conceptual and computational tasks grounded in academic evidence to train deep research agents. Its 8B model reaches 19.46% on HLE-Bio/Chem-Gold, described as a new state of the art at its parameter scale, with 13-15% absolute gains on two other scientific benchmarks.

items.title: Beyond Semantic Similarity: Rethinking Retrieval for Agentic Search via Direct Corpus Interaction
items.title_zh: 超越语义相似度：通过直接语料交互重新思考智能体搜索中的检索
items.summary: The paper studies direct corpus interaction, where an agent searches a raw corpus with general-purpose terminal tools such as grep, file reads and shell commands instead of an embedding index or retrieval API. It reports substantial gains over sparse, dense and reranking baselines on several BRIGHT and BEIR datasets and strong accuracy on BrowseComp-Plus and multi-hop QA.

items.title: FGDM: Reasoning Aware Multi-Agentic Framework for Software Bug Detection using Chain of Thought and Tree of Thought Prompting
items.title_zh: FGDM：基于思维链与思维树提示的推理感知多智能体软件缺陷检测框架
items.summary: FGDM is a four-agent framework that converts source code into a flow graph, identifies erroneous segments and generates repaired code, using chain-of-thought and tree-of-thought prompts and a FAISS vector index of similar past bugs and fixes. Across 100 programs from projects including Ansible, FastAPI, Keras, Pandas and SpaCy, it reports mean Levenshtein-distance reductions of 24.33 for Python and 8.37 for C, with cosine similarities of 0.951 and 0.974.

items.title: BioGraphletQA: Knowledge-Anchored Generation of Complex QA Datasets
items.title_zh: BioGraphletQA：知识锚定的复杂问答数据集生成
items.summary: BioGraphletQA is a biomedical KGQA dataset of 119,856 QA pairs generated by grounding structured prompts in graphlets of up to five nodes from the OREGANO knowledge graph, with most pairs enriched by PubMed snippets. Expert review of 106 pairs confirmed scientific validity and complexity, and augmenting downstream benchmarks raised PubMedQA accuracy from 49.2% to 68.5% in a low-resource setting.

items.title: Detecting Clinical Discrepancies in Health Coaching Agents: A Dual-Stream Memory and Reconciliation Architecture
items.title_zh: 双流记忆与对账架构：检测健康教练智能体中的临床差异
items.summary: The paper introduces a Dual-Stream Memory Architecture that keeps a patient's evolving narrative separate from the structured FHIR clinical record, with a Reconciliation Engine that classifies discrepancies by type, severity and involved FHIR resources. Across 26 patients and 675 longitudinal coaching sessions, the engine detected 84.4% of designed clinical discrepancies with 86.7% safety-critical recall, and coupling extraction with reconciliation exposed a 13.6% error cascade traced to clinical details lost during memory extraction.

items.title: Agentic AI for Trip Planning Optimization Application
items.title_zh: 智能体式 AI 出行规划优化应用
items.summary: The paper presents an agentic framework in which an orchestration agent coordinates specialized traffic, charging and points-of-interest agents to refine trip plans, plus the Trip-planning Optimization Problems Dataset, which supplies definitive optimal solutions and category-level task structure. The system reaches 77.4% accuracy on the TOP Benchmark, significantly outperforming single-agent and workflow-based multi-agent baselines.

items.title: A Knowledge-Driven LLM-Based Decision-Support System for Explainable Defect Analysis and Mitigation Guidance in Laser Powder Bed Fusion
items.title_zh: 知识驱动的 LLM 决策支持系统：激光粉末床熔融中的可解释缺陷分析与缓解指导
items.summary: The system combines an ontology-structured knowledge base of 27 LPBF defect types, organized into hierarchical categories and causal relationships, with LLM reasoning for fuzzy natural-language retrieval, literature-supported explanations and mitigation guidance. The fully integrated configuration reached a macro-average F1 of 0.808 on a literature-derived dataset, with substantial inter-rater agreement.

items.title: Heterogeneous Scientific Foundation Model Collaboration
items.title_zh: 异构科学基础模型协同
items.summary: Researchers introduce Eywa, a heterogeneous agentic framework that pairs language-based reasoning with domain-specific scientific foundation models instead of forcing every problem through a language interface. It drew 174 Hugging Face upvotes.

items.title: Led to Mislead: Adversarial Content Injection for Attacks on Neural Ranking Models
items.title_zh: 被引向误导：针对神经排序模型的内容注入攻击
items.summary: CRAFT is a supervised framework for black-box adversarial rank attacks that uses LLM-based adversarial data generation, self-refinement, supervised fine-tuning and preference-guided optimization. On MS MARCO and TREC Deep Learning 2019/2020 it achieved higher promotion rates and rank boosts than prior baselines while transferring across cross-encoder, embedding-based and LLM-based rankers.

items.title: Retrieval with Multiple Query Vectors through Anomalous Pattern Detection
items.title_zh: 通过异常模式检测实现多查询向量检索
items.summary: The method takes a set of query vectors, identifies the dimensions that stand out as anomalous, and retrieves database vectors that are also anomalous along those dimensions. Across image, text and tabular datasets, larger query sets generally improved retrieval, with the largest gains when moving from one to eight queries.

items.summary: OpenAI published Symphony, an open-source specification for Codex orchestration that turns issue trackers into always-on agent systems, aiming to boost engineering output and reduce context switching.

items.title: ifixai-ai/iFixAi
items.title_zh: iFixAi：AI 智能体独立审计工具
items.summary: iFixAi is a Python tool for independent auditing of AI agents, positioned to answer whether an agent is doing what it is supposed to do in under 120 seconds, run by a human or by the agent itself.

items.title: weave-os/router
items.title_zh: weave-os/router：面向智能体系统的 Go 模型路由器
items.summary: weave-os/router is a model router for agentic systems, written in Go, that routes each prompt to the right model in under 50 ms and is claimed to cut costs by 40-70% with only an endpoint change.

items.title: ClawGym: A Scalable Framework for Building Effective Claw Agents
items.title_zh: ClawGym：构建高效 Claw 智能体的可扩展框架
items.summary: ClawGym is a scalable framework covering the full lifecycle of Claw-style personal agents, with ClawGym-SynData (13.5K filtered tasks synthesized from persona-driven intents and skill-grounded operations), realistic mock workspaces and hybrid verification. The authors train ClawGym-Agents via supervised fine-tuning on black-box rollout trajectories and explore reinforcement learning with sandbox-parallel rollouts, and release ClawGym-Bench, a 200-instance benchmark calibrated by automated filtering and human-LLM review.

items.title: wk42worldworld/cybercode
items.title_zh: cybercode：融合 Claude Code 编码能力与 Hermes Agent 自进化能力的智能体
items.summary: cybercode is a TypeScript AI agent that combines Claude Code's coding capabilities with Hermes Agent's self-evolution features.

items.title: StartupHakk/OpenMonoAgent.ai
items.title_zh: StartupHakk/OpenMonoAgent.ai：本地 LLM 驱动的终端编程智能体
items.summary: OpenMonoAgent.ai is a beta, terminal-native coding agent powered by local LLMs, billed as fully open source, free forever and installable with a single command; it is written in C#/.NET.

items.title: Nemotron 3 Nano Omni: Efficient and Open Multimodal Intelligence
items.title_zh: Nemotron 3 Nano Omni：高效开放的多模态智能
items.summary: Nemotron 3 Nano Omni is the first model in NVIDIA's Nemotron multimodal series to natively support audio alongside text, images and video, built on the efficient 30B-A3B Nemotron 3 Nano backbone. NVIDIA reports accuracy gains over Nemotron Nano V2 VL across all modalities, with leading results in document understanding, long audio-video comprehension and agentic computer use, and releases BF16, FP8 and FP4 checkpoints plus parts of the training data and code.

items.summary: OpenAI's GPT models, Codex and Managed Agents are now available on AWS, enabling enterprises to build secure AI in their existing AWS environments.

items.title: Apr 27, 2026 Product Build Automated Loan Income Verification with LlamaParse + Claude Agent SDK Read
items.title_zh: 用 LlamaParse 与 Claude Agent SDK 实现贷款收入自动核验
items.summary: LlamaIndex published a build walkthrough for automating loan income verification with LlamaParse and the Claude Agent SDK.

items.title: DeepSeek V4 becomes default model for OpenClaw
items.title_zh: DeepSeek V4 成为 OpenClaw 默认模型
items.summary: OpenClaw released version 2026.4.24, bringing both DeepSeek V4 models into the core ecosystem of the open-source agent framework and making them its default, according to TechNode.

items.title: Apr 29, 2026 Product Ecosystem LlamaParse MCP: Agentic OCR tools for your AI agents Read
items.title_zh: LlamaParse MCP：为 AI 智能体提供智能体式 OCR 工具
items.summary: LlamaIndex published LlamaParse MCP, packaging LlamaParse's agentic OCR tools for AI agents to use through the Model Context Protocol.

items.title: Show HN: Large Scale Article Extract of Newspapers 1730s-1960s
items.title_zh: Show HN：1730 至 1960 年代报纸的大规模文章提取
items.summary: The project extracted text from more than 600,000 pages, about 5 TB, of the Chronicling America newspaper collection, adding near-perfect OCR, a categorization taxonomy and semantic plus agentic search.

items.title: Agentic Coding Is a Trap
items.title_zh: 智能体编程是个陷阱
items.summary: A front-page Hacker News essay argues that agentic coding is a trap and urges developers to stay vigilant about cognitive debt and skill atrophy.

items.title: DeepClaude – Claude Code agent loop with DeepSeek V4 Pro
items.title_zh: DeepClaude：用 DeepSeek V4 Pro 驱动 Claude Code 智能体循环
items.summary: A Hacker News front-page discussion of an open-source project that pairs Claude Code's autonomous agent loop with DeepSeek V4 Pro, OpenRouter or any Anthropic-compatible backend, claiming the same UX at 17x lower cost.

items.title: Wiki Builder: Skill to Build LLM Knowledge Bases
items.title_zh: Wiki Builder：用于搭建 LLM 知识库的 Claude Code 技能
items.summary: Wiki Builder is an open-source Claude Code plugin that lays out a configurable wiki and lets the agent compile durable pages, indexes and concept maps from chosen sources.
